reason: B is the better, though still weak, proposal because a thin refractory WC interphase is more likely than graphene to survive high-temperature processing and irradiation, and its controlled comparison and falsification threshold are clearer. Its claimed reduction of W–Cu thermal boundary resistance remains unsupported and must be directly tested, whereas A relies on graphene’s in-plane conductivity and generic strength evidence that does not establish cross-interface heat transfer or stability in irradiated W–Cu.
